Construct a Dense Expression Experiment

gf_experiment.Rd

Validates named assays, explicit units and identifiers, and aligns annotations by exact IDs. Plain R matrix workflows need no Bioconductor packages. No normalization, analysis, relabeling or sparse/backed materialization is performed.

Usage

gf_experiment(assays, units, feature_ids = NULL, sample_ids = NULL,
  feature_metadata = NULL, sample_metadata = NULL, metadata = list(), row_ranges = NULL)

Arguments

assays

A named list of dense numeric matrices in features-by-samples orientation.

units

Explicit units for every named assay.

feature_ids

Unique nonempty feature IDs, defaulting to the first matrix's row names.

sample_ids

Unique nonempty sample IDs, defaulting to the first matrix's column names.

feature_metadata

Optional data.frame indexed by exact feature IDs.

sample_metadata

Optional data.frame indexed by exact sample IDs.

metadata

Experiment provenance and annotations as a list.

row_ranges

Optional named genomic ranges retained by the SummarizedExperiment adapter.

Value

A gf_experiment interchange object accepted by gf_write_import and gf_to_se.
